channel.title: Comments on: Chrome “find in page” with smart search in unicode characters
channel.description: Instant Usability & Web Standards — static archive

item.title: By: Petter
item.dc:creator: Petter
item.description:
I think it’s a great thing for people who aren’t using native-language keyboards for foreign characters and symbols for international queries, but, an option to switch it off would make it more user-friendly.

Petter
